import React from 'react'; import { ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react'; import StarRating from './StarRating'; const BeerCard = ({ beer, onClick }) => (
onClick(beer)} >

{beer.name}

{beer.brewery}

{beer.style}
{beer.abv}% ABV
{beer.ibu && (
IBU: {beer.ibu}
)}
Community Rating:
{beer.averageRating ? beer.averageRating.toFixed(1) : '0.0'}
{beer.totalReviews || 0} reviews
); export default BeerCard;
